reference_sql:
WITH be07_june AS (  -- one row per BE-07 order line of June 2024
  SELECT ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-07'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
),
totals AS (  -- one row in total
  SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS revenue_stored,
         SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur / 100 - line_discount_eur) AS revenue_fixed
  FROM be07_june
)
SELECT ROUND(revenue_stored, 2) AS revenue_stored, ROUND(revenue_fixed, 2) AS revenue_fixed,
       CASE WHEN ROUND(revenue_fixed, 2) = 195532.80 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM totals

solver.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS stored,
         ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price_eur / 100) - ol.line_discount_eur AS fixed
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-07'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01 00:00:00'
), r AS (
  SELECT round(sum(stored), 2) AS revenue_stored, round(sum(fixed), 2) AS revenue_fixed FROM t
)
SELECT revenue_stored, revenue_fixed,
       CASE WHEN revenue_fixed = 195532.80 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM r
